resources.string: App Battery Tools
Targeted battery fixes. Requires Vector / Xposed API 102.
Enable battery fixes
Enable this module in Vector and select the apps you use. Wait for preparation in Status, then restart those apps. No OS restart is required.
Stop unnecessary location while area notifications are off
Prevents the area location service from starting while its setting is OFF, and releases its callbacks on termination. Enabled area notifications, maps and call screening retain original behavior.
Changes apply after restarting the selected app. Switching off restores its original behavior on the next start.

Reuse the same beacon database
Close clients arriving after a failed connection handoff
Shares one database per process and releases only newly opened clients whose handoff already failed. Active connections, notification sync and file transfers retain their original timing.
Pause Bluetooth scanning when Wi-Fi is disconnected

Pauses this app’s BLE discovery while disconnected from Wi-Fi. Requested scans resume when Wi-Fi reconnects; scans explicitly stopped in the meantime stay stopped. Existing Bluetooth connections are retained. Discovery and automatic unlock may be unavailable while using only mobile data.
Reuse repeated output-route calculations
Reuses the same output identifier and validation calculations. Device changes, audio processing, output monitoring, control-file updates and heartbeat timing remain unchanged.
Release the Matter multicast lock after controller shutdown
Releases the owned multicast lock after Matter controller shutdown and reacquires it when Matter starts again. Other discovery locks and cloud notifications are unchanged.

Stop the old sensor timer when disabled or rescheduled
Cancels the WxBeacon2 timer before its reference is cleared. Other weather updates and notifications are retained. Applies when changing the sensor setting after loading this hook.
Release mDNS locks when discovery fails before handoff
Returns newly created discovery locks if startup is abandoned before cleanup is registered. Locks adopted by concurrent discovery are retained.
Release the acquisition when Matter discovery cannot start
Rolls back only the multicast lock acquisition made by a failed startup. Existing and successful discovery retain their normal lifecycle.
Stop the diagnostic SDK’s recurring ANR polling
Prevents the reviewed diagnostic SDK from registering its 500 ms ANR polling task. That SDK’s new ANR reports are unavailable. Typing, conversion, themes and application crash handling are retained.
Weathernews

Pauses BLE discovery while disconnected from Wi-Fi and resumes requests when Wi-Fi reconnects. Existing Bluetooth connections remain. To coexist with the protected startup, preparation runs after application creation; scans already started before preparation are covered from their next registration. Discovery may be unavailable on mobile data alone.
